subject: Pilot proposal & governance path - LumenHealth
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ortiz <e.ortiz@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal & governance path - LumenHealth

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Decision-makers & timeline
- You mentioned Mark Davison (CFO) as the economic approver, Ana Ruiz (procurement) for contract/PO, and Kevin Chu (SecOps) for security review. Please confirm if any additional stakeholders should be looped in.
- Your security review window estimate was ~3 weeks; procurement typically needs 2–3 weeks after security sign-off.

2) Proposed pilot
- 6-week production-facing pilot, up to 25K tokens/day, Redwood-hosted in us-west region.
- Pilot pricing: we can offer a standard pilot credit plus a 20% promotional pilot discount if procurement signs the mutual action plan within 14 days.
- We will need a short SLA variance for pilot (proposed 99.5% uptime for pilot only) — note this is an operational concession and requires internal approval.

3) Security & compliance items (what you asked for)
- Attached: SOC2 snapshot and a mutual action plan draft. Stephanie, I included the SOC2 snapshot you sent.
- Please tell us the preferred format for evidence (S3 link, shared drive, or vendor portal).

4) Next steps / asks from LumenHealth
- Confirm economic approver (Mark?) and whether a brief 30-min call with Mark next week is possible to unblock pricing.
- Share procurement contact (Ana) and the procurement timeline for PO/contract routing.
- Confirm if Kevin (SecOps) wants a walkthrough of the deployment model and data flows.

If we get verbal confirmation from Mark + procurement contact this week we can request an internal approval for the pilot discount and SLA variance and lock a November start.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_LumenHealth.pdf (draft), SOC2-snapshot-2026-09.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a one-pager for Mark and an internal approval request once you confirm stakeholders.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Emma Ortiz <e.ortiz@lumenhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@lumenhealth.com>, Kevin Chu <kevin.chu@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal & governance path - LumenHealth

Hi Karthik — thanks for the recap, this matches our notes. A few clarifications: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: Mark Davison (CFO) will be the economic approver; Ana Ruiz (cc’d) owns procurement routing; Kevin Chu (cc’d) will handle security review. I’m also adding our Head of Data Science, Priya Shah, to future threads for success criteria.

- Security review: Kevin estimates 2–3 weeks for an initial triage and then a follow-up technical review. He prefers evidence via a secure S3 link or shared drive.

- Pricing: Mark will want a clear pilot cost vs committed discount path. He prefers to see the pilot as a low-risk evaluation with a clear ladder to committed pricing. Would you be able to provide a one-page for him that shows incremental ROI assumptions?

- Timeline: If we can get your mutual action plan & SOC snapshot this week, procurement could route paperwork starting the week of Oct 25. Pilot earliest start is early November if security and procurement align.

Looking forward to the one-pager.

Best,
Emma
Director, Clinical AI Programs | LumenHealth
e.ortiz@lumenhealth.com

Team — quick internal note and approval request so I can escalate: 

Summary: LumenHealth (prospect) is requesting a 20% pilot discount and a pilot-only SLA variance to 99.5% uptime. They’ve identified economic buyer (CFO) and procurement lead. Security review ~2–3 weeks. Procurement likely to start routing week of Oct 25 if we deliver docs this week.

Requesting: 
- Approval for 20% pilot discount (timebox: pilot only, contingent on signing mutual action plan within 14 days).
- Approval for SLA variance to 99.5% for the pilot duration only (explicitly revert to standard SLA for any committed contract).

Rationale / mitigations: 
- Pilot value prop is high (clinical inference use case) and could expand to enterprise ARR quickly.
- We will require a short MSA addendum limiting the variance scope and a rollback clause.
- Security/compliance must sign off on the deployment model before pilot launch.

Attachments: pricing_workup.xlsx (margin calc), mutual action plan (draft), SOC2 snapshot.

Please reply with explicit approval or any conditions. Rishi — can you confirm margin floor? Monica — please prep the one-pager for the CFO (ROI + pilot cost path).

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal & governance path - LumenHealth

Lauren / team — I approve the 20% pilot discount for LumenHealth on the following conditions: 

1) Margin floor: Pilot economics must show >= 25% gross margin after the discount (see pricing_workup.xlsx). If margin is below that, we need to reduce concession or secure credit coverage.
2) Timebox & rollback: Discount and SLA variance only apply to the pilot (max 6 weeks) and automatically revert to standard pricing and SLA for any committed contract.
3) Finance & credit: Finance needs a quick credit check on LumenHealth before kickoff — Karthik, please capture procurement PO cadence.
4) Security sign-off: Operations / SecOps must sign off on data-flow diagram and any exception to our standard SLA.

If these conditions are met, I authorize Lauren to notify Emma and proceed with escalation to procurement.

—Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

1) Approvals: Sales leadership has provisionally approved a 20% pilot discount and a pilot-only SLA variance to 99.5%, conditional on: margin >=25% (finance check) and security sign-off on the data-flow diagram.

2) Ask from LumenHealth this week: 
- Ana: please confirm procurement routing (PO vs signed MSA) and an estimated number of calendar days for routing once security signs off.
- Kevin: can your team confirm preferred evidence upload (S3 link preferred) and a preferred time for a 45-min walkthrough next week?
- Mark: would you be available for a 30-min call the week of Oct 26 to review the one-pager (Monica to share)?

3) Scheduling & docs: Attached is the mutual action plan (draft) and SOC2 snapshot. Monica will follow up with a one-pager and the pricing workup for finance. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345678

If we get the procurement path and Kevin’s availability this week we’ll move to lock a pilot start target of the week of Nov 2.

Thanks all — I’ll follow up with calendar invites once times are confirmed.
